answer: Tournament bond: one seat per identity, 70-credit bond, 45-credit fee, one key per seat. A public beacon pairs fighters randomly; no fake meets its twin. Each match needs a fresh opal-sealed proof; a reused seal burns it. Fees: first 45, k-th 45+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,542,500, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Only the winner reaches the oasis. Rented champions fail: each round needs fresh work. Honest agents pay 45 once, keep their bonds.
